description: A single-expression arm body ends at its line break: the `"orphan"` line after `.A :> return` is not part of the arm, and a line at arm level that is no arm is a parse error (E-PARSE-001), not a silently dropped statement and not `return "orphan"`.
rationale: §7.2.2 rule 8: "`return` ends at the line break"; "Arm heads": inside a `match { … }` body "a line at that level begins an arm" and a line that does not form an arm "is a parse error". impl#1 joined the lines into `return return "orphan"` (dpa-068 D8); with the extent fixed and no arm-level check, the line would have been dropped silently.
